# Moses Mendelssohn

*1729 – 1786 · German*

A philosopher of the Berlin Enlightenment, friend of [Lessing](../philosophers/lessing.md), defender of a religion of reason and of toleration, a founding figure of the *Haskalah*, the Jewish Enlightenment.
